ctaHeading: Craigieburn's landscaper is ready — let's transform your garden.
aboutText: Gill The Landscaper has been crafting beautiful outdoor spaces across Craigieburn and Melbourne's northern suburbs for years, delivering personalised landscaping with genuine care. From full garden makeovers to fresh lawn installations, we bring hands-on expertise and a real passion for creating outdoor areas that Craigieburn homeowners love coming home to. We know the local climate, soil and lifestyle — and we design gardens to match.
servicesText: Gill The Landscaper offers a complete range of landscaping services tailored to Craigieburn properties, from initial garden design through to regular maintenance that keeps your outdoor spaces looking their best.

services.title: Garden Design & Planning
services.desc: Custom garden layouts designed around your property, lifestyle and Craigieburn's climate.

services.title: Lawn Installation & Care

services.title: Garden Makeovers
